# Keystone Law Group

> > California probate, trust, and estate litigation law firm specializing in fiduciary disputes, elder abuse, and trust administration.

Keystone Law Group is a boutique California law firm led by partners Shawn Kerendian, Joshua Taylor, and Verlan Kwan. The firm focuses on probate litigation, trust disputes, conservatorships, undue influence cases, and fiduciary misconduct, serving both fiduciaries and beneficiaries throughout California.

## Key Topics

- Probate litigation
- Trust litigation and disputes
- Estate planning and administration
- Undue influence
- Fiduciary misconduct
- Conservatorship law
- Elder financial abuse
- Trust administration
- California Probate Code
- Spendthrift trusts
- Omitted children and heirs
- Trust amendments and validity
- Guardianship proceedings
- Estate contest
- Beneficiary rights

## Client Services

- [Who We Help](https://keystone-law.com/who-we-help): Client types served: fiduciaries, beneficiaries, probate & trust services

## Legal Guides & Resources

- [What Is Undue Influence?](https://keystone-law.com/what-is-undue-influence): Undue influence definition, elder financial abuse & mental capacity guide
- [What Makes an Amendment to a Trust Valid](https://keystone-law.com/what-makes-an-amendment-to-a-trust-valid): California trust amendment requirements & validity per Trotter v. Van Dyck
- [What Is a Motion in Limine?](https://keystone-law.com/motion-in-limine): Pretrial motion in limine guide: excluding prejudicial evidence at trial

## Notable Cases & Legal Analysis

- [Defeating a Spendthrift Trust | Keystone Helps Make New Law in Blech v. Blech](https://keystone-law.com/defeating-a-spendthrift-trust-keystone-helps-make-new-law-in-blech-v-blech): Blech v. Blech case: defeating spendthrift clauses for judgment collection
- [What California Omitted Children Must Prove to Inherit Under the 'Sole Reason' Rule](https://keystone-law.com/california-omitted-children-sole-reason-rule): Estate of Williams case analysis on omitted children's inheritance rights
- [Marrying into Elder Abuse: A Cautionary Tale](https://keystone-law.com/marrying-into-elder-abuse-a-cautionary-tale): Late-life marriage capacity, undue influence & omitted spouse protections
- [Inside Jay Leno's Conservatorship of Wife Mavis: 5 Key Takeaways](https://keystone-law.com/jay-leno-wife-conservatorship): Jay Leno's conservatorship case analyzed: dementia, elder care & guardianship
- [What's Going on With Wendy Williams and Wells Fargo?](https://keystone-law.com/wells-fargo-wendy-williams): Wendy Williams vs Wells Fargo: financial guardianship case explained
